description:
The process begins when a customer files a complaint about a product or service.
Customer service logs the complaint and assigns it to the relevant department for investigation.
After reviewing the details, the team determines whether the complaint is valid and whether a refund is justified and notifies the customer with the decision.
If a refund is approved, the financial team processes the reimbursement.
The complaint is marked as resolved once the customer receives the refund or directly after notifying the customer in case the refund was rejected.
After resolving the case, customers can provide feedback on their satisfaction.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Complaint"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/complaint">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Complaint" name="Complaint"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Decision" name="Complaint decision"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Refund" name="Reimbursement"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Feedback" name="Customer satisfaction feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Complaint">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer" processRef="Process_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Organization" name="Organization" processRef="Process_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Complaint" name="Files complaint"
                      sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="Start_Complaint"
                      messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Decision" name="Notifies customer of decision"
                      sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"
                      messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Refund" name="Provides reimbursement"
                      sourceRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRefund"
                      messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Provides satisfaction feedback"
                      sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Participant_Organization"
                      messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="File complaint and provide feedback" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Customer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_FileComplaint" name="File complaint about product or service"
                   messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveDecision" name="Receive complaint decision"
                      messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerRefund" name="Refund approved?"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveRefund" name="Receive reimbursement"
                      messageRef="Message_Refund"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerRefundMerge" name="Continue after decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerFeedback" name="Provide feedback?"
                           default="Flow_CustomerFeedback_No"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ProvideFeedback" name="Provide feedback on satisfaction"
                   messageRef="Message_Feedback"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerFeedbackMerge" name="Continue after feedback"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Customer participation complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow_01" sourceRef="Start_Customer" targetRef="Task_FileComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow_02" sourceRef="Task_FileComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveDecision" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerRefund"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow_04" name="Refund approved"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerRefund" targetRef="Task_ReceiveRefund">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refund is approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow_05" name="Refund rejected"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerRefund" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow_06" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveRefund" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow_07" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerRefundMerge" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow_Feedback_Yes" name="Feedback provided"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerFeedback" targetRef="Task_ProvideFeedback">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customer chooses to provide feedback</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CustomerFeedback_No" name="No feedback"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerFeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow_10" sourceRef="Task_ProvideFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerFeedbackMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="CustomerFlow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerFeedbackMerge" targetRef="End_Customer"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Complaint" name="Handle product or service complaint" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Complaint">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_CustomerService" name="Customer service">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_LogComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssignComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Department" name="Relevant department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReviewComplaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_NotifyCustomer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_RefundMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_MarkResolved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Complaint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Finance" name="Financial team">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProcessReimbursement</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Complaint" name="Complaint filed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Complaint" messageRef="Message_Complaint"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LogComplaint" name="Log complaint"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssignComplaint" name="Assign complaint to relevant department"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReviewComplaint" name="Review details and determine complaint validity and refund justification"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCustomer" name="Notify customer of decision"
                   messageRef="Message_Decision"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundDecision" name="Refund approved?"
                           default="Flow_RefundRejected"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProcessReimbursement" name="Process reimbursement"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RefundMerge" name="Continue after refund decision"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MarkResolved" name="Mark complaint as resolved"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Complaint" name="Complaint handling complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Complaint" targetRef="Task_LogComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_LogComplaint" targetRef="Task_AssignComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_AssignComplaint" targetRef="Task_ReviewComplaint"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_ReviewComplaint" targetRef="Task_NotifyCustomer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCustomer" targetRef="Gateway_RefundDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundApproved" name="Refund approved"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">refund is approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RefundRejected" name="Refund rejected"
                       sourceRef="Gateway_RefundDecision" targetRef="Gateway_RefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_ProcessReimbursement" targetRef="Gateway_RefundMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Gateway_RefundMerge" targetRef="Task_MarkResolved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_MarkResolved" targetRef="End_Complaint"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
